image_description: A top-down view of a dark-shelled turtle, likely a mud turtle, situated on a forest floor covered in dry leaves, twigs, and sparse green vegetation. The turtle's head and limbs are fully retracted into the shell, making them invisible. The carapace is high-domed, oval, and dark brown/black with a glossy texture and visible longitudinal ridges (keels).
